whatItIs.statement: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

whenToUse.statement: Use Slider when the user should choose a numeric value or range along a continuous scale.

howToUse.statement: Use a one-number array such as defaultValue={[33]} for a single-value slider.
Use two or more values in the value/defaultValue array when a range or multiple thumbs are required.

options.statement: Use orientation="vertical" for a vertical slider.
Use disabled to make the slider unavailable and dir="rtl" when direction needs to be explicit.
